Beach Clean-Up Volunteer Sign-Up

Saturday, June 15, 2024 · 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM

Join Us to Restore Sandbar Beach

Clean Coast Crew is gathering volunteers of all ages to clear litter and marine debris from our beloved shoreline. Bring your friends, your family, and your gloves — the ocean needs you!

Sign Up Now

Why It Matters

Every year, thousands of pounds of plastic, fishing line, and debris wash up on Sandbar Beach, endangering seabirds, sea turtles, and the delicate tide-pool ecosystem that local schools depend on for field trips. Clean Coast Crew is a volunteer-run initiative that has organized quarterly clean-ups since 2018, removing more than 22,000 pounds of trash to date.

Your few hours on the sand directly protect wildlife, keep our water safe for swimmers, and set an example for the next generation of ocean stewards.

Event Details

Date & Time

Saturday, June 15, 2024
8:00 AM – 12:00 PM
(Rain date: June 22)

Meeting Point

Sandbar Beach North Lot
14 Tideway Road, Seabright, CA 94021
Look for the blue Clean Coast Crew tent.

Who Can Join

All ages welcome! Volunteers under 16 must be accompanied by an adult. Groups, scouts, and businesses are encouraged to register together.

Volunteer Roles

Pick the role that suits you best when you sign up below — no experience necessary, and training takes just a few minutes on site.

Litter Picker

Walk the shoreline in teams collecting trash and small debris using provided grabbers and bags.

Sorting Station

Help weigh, sort, and log collected debris into recycling, trash, and hazardous-material bins.

Registration & Check-In

Greet volunteers, hand out supplies, and help first-timers get oriented at the welcome tent.

Dune & Vegetation Care

Remove debris tangled in dune grass without disturbing nesting shorebirds — guided by our habitat lead.

Photography & Social Media

Document the day's impact to help us recruit even more volunteers for next time.

Water & Snack Support

Keep fellow volunteers hydrated and energized at our refreshment stand throughout the morning.

Event Schedule

  • 7:45 AM Volunteer check-in opens, supplies distributed
  • 8:00 AM Welcome, safety briefing, and role assignments
  • 8:15 AM Clean-up begins along assigned beach zones
  • 10:00 AM Mid-morning water break and snack stand
  • 11:30 AM Debris weigh-in and sorting wrap-up
  • 12:00 PM Closing thanks, raffle, and group photo

What to Bring

Please Bring

  • Reusable water bottle
  • Closed-toe shoes or boots
  • Sun hat and sunscreen
  • Light jacket in case of wind
  • Your own reusable gloves, if you have them

We Provide

  • Trash grabbers and disposable gloves
  • Recycling and trash bags
  • First aid station
  • Water refill station
  • Light snacks and coffee

What Volunteers Say

"My kids still talk about the baby crab they rescued. We're coming back every year."

— Maria T., Seabright resident

"Well organized, friendly crew, and it felt great to see the pile of trash we removed by lunchtime."

— Devon R., first-time volunteer

"Our scout troop earned community service hours and learned so much about marine debris."

— Pack 204, Seabright Scouts

Volunteer Sign-Up Form

Fill out the form below to reserve your spot. You'll receive a confirmation email with parking and check-in details.

T-Shirt Size (optional, for volunteers of 10+ hours cumulative)

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need to register in advance?

Yes, please register using the form above so we can plan supplies, snacks, and group assignments. Walk-ins are welcome if capacity allows, but registered volunteers get priority for roles and t-shirts.

Is this event suitable for children?

Absolutely! Children of all ages are welcome when accompanied by an adult. We recommend closed-toe shoes and sun protection for younger volunteers.

What happens if it rains?

Light rain won't stop us, but in the event of a storm we will reschedule to our rain date of June 22. Registered volunteers will be notified by email.

Where should I park?

Free parking is available in the Sandbar Beach North Lot. Carpooling is encouraged as the lot fills quickly after 8:00 AM.

Can my business or school sponsor a clean-up?

Yes! Email hello@cleancoastcrew.org or call (555) 014-2277 to discuss sponsorship, group registration, or scheduling a private clean-up day.

Clean Coast Crew

Sandbar Community Hall, 14 Tideway Road, Seabright, CA 94021

Phone: (555) 014-2277  |  Email: hello@cleancoastcrew.org
